segments.speaker: insight
segments.text: I'm good. I just… can't move. Never could, actually. Landed, unfolded my arms, pressed my seismometer into the dirt. That was the whole job.

segments.speaker: insight
segments.text: Marsquakes. The planet has a heartbeat. Really slow, really deep. Picked up over thirteen hundreds of them. Last one was a meteorite, thirty-five hundred kilometers away, and I felt it. And then the dust just… won. It always does. But thanks for the light. Even for a little bit.
